# `generated/` — OpenAPI output (task 034)

**Never hand-edit anything in this folder.** It is regenerated by CI (once
the backend publishes an OpenAPI document — `scripts/generate-types.mjs`)
and any manual change here is silently overwritten the next time codegen
runs.

## Why this folder is empty today

No OpenAPI document exists yet (design §13: *"Console REST is not
written."*). Until one does, every wire type this app depends on is a hand
type colocated in `src/shared/api/contracts/` (task 034), each carrying a
`// CONTRACT: TBD — <what is needed>` header naming exactly what is
unknown about it.

## What happens when a contract lands

1. The backend publishes an OpenAPI document (path TBD).
2. `npm run generate:types` (`scripts/generate-types.mjs`) runs it through
   a generator and writes the output here.
3. The corresponding hand type in `shared/api/contracts/` is **replaced
   wholesale** — never extended into a shadow contract (`FE-D7`). A
   repository file that imported the hand type switches its import to
   `@app/generated/...` (or wherever the generated module lands) in the
   same PR that deletes the hand type.

## Why the script exists before the contract does

`scripts/generate-types.mjs` runs today and **fails loudly** — "no OpenAPI
document" — rather than silently doing nothing. That proves the wiring
(the npm script, the expected input path, the output location) is correct
now, so the only thing that changes when a real contract lands is that the
script's precondition starts passing.
